title: Household of God
definition: The Household of God describes the Church as God's family, built on apostolic truth with Christ as the cornerstone.
summary: The Household of God portrays the Church as God's family, where believers live as brothers and sisters under the Father.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the cornerstone who holds God's household together.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: This doctrine focuses on the family nature of the Church. Believers are not merely attendees, volunteers, or audience members; they are members of God's household. The image calls for affection, responsibility, honor, patience, and care across generations and backgrounds.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This matters because church life becomes cold when it is treated only as organization. The household of God reminds believers that doctrine creates a family, not a platform. It also challenges favoritism, neglect, and relational distance inside the congregation.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Treat fellow believers as family in Christ, not as interruptions or ministry units. Practice patience, honor older and younger saints, and notice those who are lonely. Ask how your presence can make God's household warmer, safer, and more faithful.
